title: Logspace-uniform circuit characterization of P
statement: A language $L$ over the Boolean alphabet belongs to polynomial time if and only if there is a family of Boolean circuits that recognizes exactly $L$, has fan-in at most two, has size bounded by a polynomial in the input length, and is logspace-uniform.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
